However, this aspect also grants you a unique ability to navigate the unseen realms, uncovering hidden patterns and connections (4).

Your Venus in Scorpio suggests a passionate and intense approach to relationships, with a strong desire for depth and intimacy (5). Yet, your Saturn in the 12th house indicates a tendency to self-sabotage and fear of being overwhelmed (6). Your North Node in the 4th house suggests a need to reconnect with your roots and inner world (7).
